changes: new category group audit: audit_at_expiration_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates audits should be performed for this policy at expiration.'), audit_monthly_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates audits should be performed for this policy monthly.'), audit_semi_annual_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates audits should be performed for this policy semi-annually.'), audit_other_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates audits should be performed for this policy at a frequency other than those listed.'), audit_quarterly_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates audits should be performed for this policy quarterly.')

new category group group_p1: participating_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates the policy is a participating policy. A Participating policy may result in reduced premiums through the payment of policyholder dividends declared by the insurer. Some policyholder dividends are based on actual experience of the applicant. If such a program is available through the company in the covered state, indicate whether the policy is to be on a Participating or Non-Participating basis. Check with your company on the availability of plans.'), non_participating_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates the policy is a non-participating policy.')

new category group deductible: deductible_medical_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates the deductible type is Medical in the state where coverage is being applied for. (In Pennsylvania, the deductible is "per claim". The deductible choices are $1,000, $5,000 and $10,000.)'), deductible_indemnity_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates the deductible type is Indemnity in the state where coverage is being applied for. (In Pennsylvania, the deductible is "per claim". The deductible choices are $1,000, $5,000 and $10,000.)'), deductible_other_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates the deductible type is other than those listed.')

new category group group_p1_2: uslh_ind ("Check the box (if applicable): Indicates United States Longshoremen's & Harbor Worker's (USL&H) coverage is requested. Exposures for this optional coverages as well as additional coverages should be described in the Specify Additional Coverages/Endorsements section."), managed_care_option_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates Managed Care Option is requested. Exposures for this optional coverages as well as additional coverages should be described in the Specify Additional Coverages/Endorsements section.'), voluntary_comp_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates Voluntary Compensation coverage is requested. Exposures for this optional coverages as well as additional coverages should be described in the Specify Additional Coverages/Endorsements section.'), other_coverage_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates other coverages than those listed are being requested.'), foreign_cov_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates Foreign coverage is requested. Exposures for this optional coverages as well as additional coverages should be described in the Specify Additional Coverages/Endorsements section.'), other_coverage_2_ind ('Check the box (if applicable): Indicates other coverages than those listed are being requested.')

units.name: privacy_notice_given_ind
units.description: Check the box (if applicable): Indicates that a copy of the Notice of Information Practices (ACORD 38 or state specific ACORD 38) has been given to the applicant. State specific 38s are available for applicants in AZ, DE, KS, MN, ND, NY, OR, VA, and WV. In addition, ACORD 38 contains CA and MA state specific language.
